text: {"name":"bt_link_tx_prepare","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Prepares the link transmit state from the current RF channel data, updates per-link counters, and may submit a control PDU.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"tx_context","v2":"per_link_tx_state","v6":"channel_state","v7":"tx_buffer","v14":"remaining_count","v18":"link_index","v19":"control_pdu_payload"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":28,"meaning":"Pointer to the active transmit buffer."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Transmit length computed from channel-state fields."},{"offset":107,"meaning":"Link index used to select per-link state and included in the control PDU."},{"offset":227,"meaning":"Countdown/reload byte mirrored to per-link state and decremented during setup."},{"offset":230,"meaning":"Mode byte controlling a per-link flag and the function's return value."},{"offset":231,"meaning":"Countdown byte decremented during setup and used when preparing a control PDU."},{"offset":232,"meaning":"Transmit-buffer offset where the decremented count is written."},{"offset":233,"meaning":"Optional second transmit-buffer offset where the count is written."}]}
